chapter.verse: Tu-in Jesu in lampai kawmin pianpih khuamulo khat mu hi.
A nungzuite in Jesu' kiangah, “Rabbi aw, hih mipa khuamulo-in a pian pen a mawh kua ahi hiam? Amah hiam, ama' nulehpa hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Amah ahi-a ama' nulehpa ahi zongin kuamah mawh lo a, hih pen Pasian' sepnate ama' sungah a kilat theih nading ahi hi.
Kuamah in na a sep theihloh hun, zan khuamial hong tung ding ahih manin sun khuavak sungin kei hong sawlpa' nasepte i sep kul hi.
Kei pen leitung ah ka om laiteng leitung khuavak ka hi hi.”
Hih thu teng a gen khit ciangin leilak ah cilsia-in a cil tawh buan bawl hi. Tua ciangin mipa' mit buan nuh a,
“Pai inla Siloam bual ah va sil in,” ci hi. (Siloam a khiatna Sawlkhiat ahi hi). Mipa zong pai-in va sil a, khuamusa-in hong ciah hi.
A vengte leh amah khutdawhngen ahih lai-a a mu ngei mite in, “Hih mipa khutdawh ngen-a a tu den pen hilo ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Kimkhat in, “Tua pa himah hi,” ci uh a, a dangte in, “Hilo hi, a kisun hi bek hi,” ci uh hi. Tua mipa in ahihleh, “Tua mipa ka himah hi,” ci den hi.
Tua ciangin mite in, “Tua ahihleh na mitte bangci kihon theih ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Mipa in, “Jesu a kici mipa in buan bawlin ka mit hong nuhsak a, ‘Siloam ah pai inla va sil in,’ hong ci hi. Kei zong pai-in ka sil a, khua ka mu thei hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Tua mipa koi ah om ahi hiam?” a cih uh ciangin, “Ka thei kei hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in Pharisee-te' kiangah tua khuamulo ngeipa paipih uh hi.
Hih bangin Jesu buan bawlin mipa' mit a honsak ni pen Sabbath ni ahi hi.
Tua hangin Pharisee-te in mipa' kiangah khua a muhtheihzia dongkik uh hi. Mipa in, “Amah in ka mit buan hong nuhsak a, tua ka sil ciangin khua ka mu thei hi,” ci hi.

Pharisee mi kimkhat in, “Hih mipa Pasian' kiangpan hilo hi. A hang pen Sabbath tang lo hi,” ci uh hi. Ahi zongin kimkhat in, “Mawhnei mi khat in hih bang kihilna limte bangci bawl theih ding ahi hiam?” ci uh hi. Tua hi a, amaute' kikal ah lungsim kikakna om hi.
Tua hangin amaute in khuamulo mipa' kiangah, “Tua mipa in na mit hong honsak ci lehang amah na bangci ngaihsut hiam?” ci leuleu uh hi. “Amah kamsang khat hi,” ci-in khuamulo mipa in dawng hi.
Jew mite in hih mipa khuamulo ngei ahihlam leh khuamukik ta ahihlam um tuanlo uh ahih manin khuamukik mipa' nulehpa sam uh a,
“Na tapa uh, pianpih khuamulo na cih pen uh, hih pa ahi hiam? Ahihleh tu-in khua bangci muhkik hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Ama' nulehpa in, “Hih pen ka tapa uh ahihlam leh pianpih khuamulo ahihlam ka thei uh hi.
Ahi zongin tu-in khua bangci muhkik cih thu leh a mit kua'n honsak cih thu ka thei kei uh hi. Amah khangcing khin ahih manin amah dong un. Ama' thu amahmah in hong gen ding hi,” ci uh hi.

(Hih bangin ama' nulehpa in a genna pen Jew mite a kihtak man uh ahi hi. Banghanghiam cihleh Jesu pen Khris hi, ci-in a pulak peuhmah vengkhawm innte pan hawlkhia ding, ci-in Jew mite kithukim khinzo uh ahih man hi.
Tua hangin a nulehpa in, “Amah khangcing khin ahih manin amah dong un,” a ci uh ahi hi.)
Tua ahih manin amaute in khuamulo ngeipa a nihveina sam leuleu uh a, “Pasian minpha pia in. Hih mipa mawhnei ahihlam ka thei uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Amah in, “Tua mipa mawhnei hiam, nei lo hiam, ka thei kei hi. Thu khat bek ka thei a, khuamulo ngei ka hih hangin tu-in khuamu ka hita hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Tua mipa in hong bangci bawl ahi hiam? Na mitte hong bangci honsak hiam?” ci uh hi.
Amah in, “Note kong gen khinzo a, thu na ngai kei uh hi. Bang hangin khatvei zakik nuam leuleu na hi uh hiam? Note zong ama' nungzuite suak nuam na hi uh hiam?” ci hi.
Amau zong kobawl uh a, “Nang ama' nungzui na hi a, ko pen Moses' nungzuite ka hi uh hi.
Pasian in Moses' tungah thugen cih ka thei uh a, ahih hangin hih mipa ahihleh amah koi pan hong pai cih ka theikei uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Mipa in, “Hih pen lamdang hi. No lah amah koi pan hong pai cih thei lo, amah'n lah ka mitte hong honsak.
Pasian in mawhneite' thu ngai lo ahih hangin mi khatpeuh in Pasian zahtak henla Ama' deihna zui hileh Pasian in zong tua mipa' thu ngai cih ka thei uh hi.
Pianpih khuamulo khat a mitte a honsak mi cih bang leitung piancil-a kipan kiza ngeilo hi.
Hih mipa Pasian' kiangpan hilo hileh bangmah hih theilo ding hi,” ci hi.
Amaute in, “Mawhna tawh kidimsa-a suak hinapi-in kote thu hong hilh sawm zen na hi hiam?” ci-in amah hawlkhia uh hi.
Tua mipa a kihawlkhiat thu Jesu in za ahih manin amah a muh ciangin, “Mihing' Tapa na um hiam?” ci-in dong hi.
Amah in, “Sya aw, ka up theih nadingin amah kua ahi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Amah na mu khinzo hi. Nang tawh kiho pen amah ahi hi,” ci hi.
(Amah in, “Topa aw, ka um hi,” ci-in Jesu bia hi.)
Jesu in, “Thukhenna bawl dingin leitung hong pai ka hi a, khuamulo mite khua a muh nading leh khua a mu mite khuamulo a suah nading ahi hi,” ci hi.
Ama' kimnai-a om Pharisee mi kimkhat in hih thute a zak uh ciangin Jesu' kiangah, “Ko zong khuamulo ka hi uh hiam?” ci uh hi.
Jesu in, “Khuamulo hileh uhcin mawhbaanglo na hiding uh hi. Ahi zongin, ‘Khua ka mu uh hi,’ ci na hih manun mawhbaang na suak uh hi,” ci-in dawng hi.
